_comment: Buoy rule exceptions, keyed by spot slug, honoured by enrichment/buoys.compute_nearest_buoy (enrich) and by pipeline/buoy_assign.py (sw1-raycast buoy-assign), so a full run reproduces the committed roster. 'pin': the spot keeps this buoy whether or not the rule's line of sight passes (its distance is measured from the rule's point as usual, its fallbacks are the rule's passing buoys other than it); a pin to a station that is not a wave station on the list is ignored with a warning, so a pin never holds a silent buoy. 'exclude': these stations are never the spot's buoy or fallbacks. Every entry carries its reason and evidence. Decided 2026-11-13 after run 75.

baileys-beach.name: Baileys Beach
baileys-beach.reason: Its line to 44085 (24.65 km) crosses 0.60 km of land: under 2 km, a point or bar of the same coast, so the nearer working buoy measures the water the spot faces; the rule's choice in sight is 44097 at 56.53 km.
baileys-beach.evidence: sw1-raycast run 75 (docs/face_validation/run-75), line traced over GSHHG v2.3.7 full resolution; decided 2026-11-13 (group D)
